countingRules: Gold SAME is a positive, DIFFERENT a negative; UNSURE is excluded from every rate and counted separately.
Only ACCEPTED is a predicted match (merge). REJECTED, UNRESOLVED and CONFLICT are all 'not merged'.
TP = SAME and ACCEPTED; FP = DIFFERENT and ACCEPTED; FN = SAME and not ACCEPTED (UNRESOLVED and CONFLICT on a SAME pair cost recall); TN = DIFFERENT and not ACCEPTED.
CONFLICT is never merged, so it is never a TP or FP.
Coverage = (ACCEPTED + REJECTED) / included pairs. Unresolved rate = UNRESOLVED / included. Conflict rate = CONFLICT / included.
Decided-only recall = TP / (SAME pairs that were ACCEPTED or REJECTED).
llmPath: LLM-adjudicated path: the run used only the deterministic FAKE adjudicator (`fake-deterministic-adjudicator-v1`), never a model. Pairs in the LLM band: 0; decided by the adjudicator: 0. Every LLM-path figure is fake-adjudicator output or not applicable, never a model result.

thresholdSensitivity.note: Counterfactual over the run's recorded weighted scores; reporting only, the er-v1 thresholds are not changed. `policy-score-path` re-thresholds only decisions the thresholds governed (PROBABILISTIC or LLM_ADJUDICATED path decided by score; exact-ID, bibliographic, name-gate and generic-title decisions keep their recorded outcome). `score-only` decides every non-CONFLICT pair by score alone, ignoring all deterministic rules (CONFLICT stays CONFLICT). In both, a score between reject and accept is UNRESOLVED: no adjudicator is run.
